text: Entry Requirements Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy; Applicants shall hold a high school diploma before September 1, 2026; Applicants should not be older than 25; Applicants’ academic grade in the previous stage should not be less than 75%; Applicants shall complete the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) prior to the application deadline. Relevant test subjects, download here . Applicants for English-taught Programs should have the English proficiency of IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 85/TOEFL Essentials 9/Duolingo 100 or above. Applicants who previously held Chinese citizenship shall have obtained foreign nationality and renounced their Chinese nationality before April 30, 2022. Additionally, they shall have resided abroad for more than 2 years between April 30, 2022 to April 30, 2026. (Record of actual foreign residency for 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, referring to the entry and exit date signatures).
